title: 'Buy now, pay later' has gone mainstream, but personal finance expert warns of risks
summary: News article on Gallup/Bankrate survey data showing BNPL's mainstream adoption and the risks a personal-finance expert highlights.

assertions.quote: those who said they don't have enough money to live comfortably were nearly three times as likely to say they used installment plans
nearly half of BNPL users experienced problems, including overspending, missing payments or regretting their purchases
BNPL works best for occasional, necessary big-ticket items rather than routine spending on gas, groceries or food delivery
splitting purchases into smaller payments can make expensive items feel more affordable than they really are
